title: 黄循财谈 AI 机遇与新加坡就业
titleEn: PM Wong on AI opportunities and Singapore jobs
summary: 总理黄循财在论坛表示，AI 热潮不会永久，新加坡应抓住机遇培养新能力、保护劳动者就业。
summaryEn: PM Lawrence Wong discusses how the temporary AI boom presents an opportunity for Singapore to build new capabilities while protecting workers rather than individual jobs.
speaker: Lawrence Wong
